ValidationRule.description: To mark an opportunity won, Infosec and Legal reviews must be completed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), IsWon , RecordType.Name = "Sales" , NOT(ISPICKVAL( Infosec_Review__c , "Not Required" )), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Infosec_Review__c , "Completed" )), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Legal_Review__c , "Not Required" )), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Infosec_Review__c , "Completed" )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To mark this opportunity as won, please update the Legal Review and Infosec Review fields.
